presentation: An eased sweep from the far side to the starting party. 1.5 seconds for an 8x6 board, 2.5 seconds for medium boards, four seconds for larger boards. Confirm/cancel/Start can skip on consoles; keyboard, controller and touch skip in Godot. Gameplay waits; camera movement cannot reveal hidden rooms. Intro movement is excluded from player-scrolling metrics.
scenery: Shared orchard mulch basins and supports, cart crates and cask, fuller console garden beds and weathered wall feet. Broader N64 undergrowth and rounded PS1 meadow shrubs. No simulation, objective or campaign-layout changes.
